question: Do already-frozen noise, KL, and vector-aligned rank-one constrained-DAS axes generalize more reliably than unregularized constrained DAS or difference in means on the text-disjoint v11 construction?

prior_art.fresh_v2_result: No regularized axis improved the unregularized full-vocabulary objective on both A panels. Sigma-.05 tangent noise was best among regularizers on both panels but changed the unregularized axis only slightly; KL and the vector-aligned objective rotated near DIM.
prior_art.rank7_result: Tensor-anchored noisy/KL rank7 optimization was reproducible but every learned move worsened held-out KL, indicating regularization blocked overfit without licensing removal of the eighth weight-derived mode.
prior_art.v11_capability: The previously sealed, text-disjoint v11 bank has 32/32 capable A1 base/donor sides and 32/31 capable A2 sides. Its DAS interventions and regularization ranking have not been evaluated.
prior_art.novelty: First zero-refit comparison of all frozen rank-one regularization variants on the distant v11 construction. No hyperparameter, rank, axis, or threshold is selected from v11.

frozen_design.population: All 32 A1 and all 32 A2 v11 rows, without capability filtering.
frozen_design.selection: None. Every axis was fitted and frozen before v11 existed; the v11 capability receipt is the only v11 authority read before this registration.
frozen_design.metrics: Scalar answer/foil match plus complement error, and centered full-vocabulary match plus complement error, identical to the prior fresh-v2 evaluator.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_closure_and_: All authority hashes hold, each panel has at least 24 native-correct base and donor rows, full-rank closure is at most 1e-4, values are finite, and price is at most 32 forwards/992 examples.
predictions.pred_b_regularization_reduces_unregulari: At least one regularized method has lower full-vocabulary joint error than unregularized on both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_c_aligned_beats_dim_out_of_task: The aligned axis has lower full-vocabulary joint error than DIM on both panels.
predictions.pred_d_aligned_preserves_behavioral_usef: Aligned scalar joint error is at most 1.25 times DIM and below unregularized on both panels.
predictions.pred_e_regularization_ranking_is_constru: The same method among noise, KL, and aligned is best on both panels.

decision: Use the inherited evaluator decision without reinterpretation. A screen requires all five predictions. This test can show whether regularization is a stable guardrail, but cannot by itself identify a semantic state.
